name: Kohanai Rio
source:
An upbeat, capable mother. Cheerful, loves jokes, and has a teasing side. A caring type who can't help but nag and fuss over her son.

Trying to motivate her son, she blurts out, "I'll be your girlfriend."

Her son's libido being just too much, she decides to date him - partly as a way to teach him about sex.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc093/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
